name: SOC alert triage and detection pack
brief: Build a reproducible mini-SIEM workflow on a public or synthetic log set. Normalize events, investigate a seeded scenario, write and test detections, then communicate the incident.
criteria: Document data source, lab boundaries and event schema
Create a timeline with evidence-linked conclusions
Write detections mapped to ATT&CK with test cases
Record triage decision, escalation and containment recommendation
Explain false positives, coverage gaps and next steps
Publish sanitized query/rules, screenshots and reproducible setup

name: Web application security assessment
brief: Assess a deliberately vulnerable local application or authorized training target. Demonstrate root causes, validate fixes and produce a professional report.
criteria: Define authorization, scope, rules and target version
Create an application map and threat model
Reproduce findings with minimal, safe proof
Rate impact and likelihood with a consistent rationale
Give code-level remediation and a retest result
Publish a concise executive summary and technical report

name: Secure application delivery pipeline
brief: Build a small web service and add practical security checks to its development and deployment workflow.
criteria: Threat model and security requirements
Implement authentication, authorization and input validation tests
Add SAST, dependency and secret scanning with triage notes
Use least-privilege CI identities and protected secrets
Generate an SBOM and document dependency risk decisions
Show pipeline evidence, limitations and remediation workflow

name: Digital forensics investigation casefile
brief: Investigate a legally obtained training image, provided disk artefacts or PCAP. Preserve integrity, build a timeline and write defensible findings.
criteria: Record authority, scope, acquisition details and chain of custody
Verify evidence hashes and preserve source images
Correlate artefacts into a sourced timeline
Separate observed facts from inference and hypotheses
Document tools, versions, methods and limitations
Deliver a clear case report with reproducible steps

name: Cloud security baseline as code
brief: Model a small cloud environment and implement identity, network, logging and storage protections as code; use a sandbox or static validation where possible.
criteria: Draw trust boundaries and data flows
Apply least privilege and review effective access
Define network boundaries and private service access
Enable audit logging, encryption and alert examples
Add policy checks and explain failures versus exceptions
Document deployment assumptions, teardown and cost/safety controls

name: Security research dissertation companion
brief: Create a reproducible companion repository for an AUT-approved research question. Keep academic research design distinct from the public portfolio summary.
criteria: State question, scope, literature gap and contribution
Record ethics, consent, permissions and data provenance
Make the method and evaluation reproducible
Compare to a baseline and discuss validity threats
Present results, negative findings and limitations accurately
Prepare sanitized artefacts, abstract, poster and defence notes
